executable.title: Annotations Measure
executable.description: Read the vector annotations placed on a volume and emit derived annotations back onto it. The Slicer Execution Model has no vector element, so both sides are <file> params declaring the annotations extension.

image.name: inputVolume
image.label: Input Volume
image.description: Volume the annotations were placed on (DICOM, NIfTI, NRRD, MHA, etc.)

file.name: inputAnnotations
file.label: Input Annotations
file.description: Rulers, rectangles and polygons placed on the input volume.

file.name: outputAnnotations
file.label: Output Annotations
file.description: Derived annotations to apply to the input volume.

double.name: margin
double.label: Margin
double.description: Margin in millimeters added around each derived annotation.

parameters.label: Girder API
parameters.description: Server access injected by slicer_cli_web; not shown to users.
